title: Tracing Target Answers in Poisoned Retrieval Corpora via Token Influence Attribution
abstract: arXiv:2606.25721v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems are vulnerable to corpus poisoning attacks that manipulate model outputs through malicious retrieved documents. Existing detection methods typically rely on auxiliary classifiers or additional LLM-based verification, introducing substantial computational overhead. We present TRACE, a lightweight detection framework that identifies poisoning attacks by tracing answer-related tokens through token influence attribution. TRACE first discovers recurrent high-influence keywords across retrieved documents and then performs a secondary verification to confirm their influence on model predictions. Experiments on three QA benchmarks and six LLMs demonstrate strong detection performance while simultaneously uncovering attacker-specified target answers.

translated_title: 通过令牌影响归因追踪中毒检索语料库中的目标答案
translated_abstract: 摘要：检索增强生成（RAG）系统容易受到语料库中毒攻击，这种攻击通过恶意检索到的文档操纵模型输出。现有的检测方法通常依赖于辅助分类器或额外的基于LLM的验证，这引入了大量的计算开销。我们提出了TRACE，一个轻量级检测框架，通过令牌影响归因来追踪与答案相关的令牌，从而识别中毒攻击。TRACE首先在检索到的文档中发现重复出现的高影响力关键词，然后进行二次验证以确认它们对模型预测的影响。在三个问答基准和六个LLM上的实验表明，TRACE具有强大的检测性能，同时还能揭示攻击者指定的目标答案。
tldr: TRACE是一个轻量级框架，通过令牌影响归因追踪高影响力关键词，有效检测RAG系统中的语料库中毒攻击，并揭示攻击者指定的目标答案。
en_tdlr: TRACE is a lightweight framework that detects corpus poisoning attacks in RAG systems by tracing high-influence keywords via token influence attribution, effectively revealing attacker-specified target answers.
